text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Man, what a massive crowd.
Rudolf sure has her hands full.

The season for the Fan Appreciation Festival has arrived.
This year's featured main event is—

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, for the next exhibition match,
Ace and C.B. are both running!

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Huh! The other contenders are pretty tough too.
I wonder who's gonna win?

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's gotta be C.B.!
She's overwhelmingly the best out of this group!

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! Man, I can't wait!
I really want to see her take the win.

Even though it was just an exhibition...
the ones running were active, prominent Umamusume.
The fervor of the venue surpassed even that of a real racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, that's a familiar face!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Phew.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I've changed.
I'm not gonna be scared or flinch anymore."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'll beat CB.
No, I'm going to win the race!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I don't care who's there!
I don't care what happens!
I'm gonna snatch it all for myself!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Whoa! You were here!?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
All right...
Today's race is gonna be interesting!

And so, the 2000m turf
exhibition match began.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
...Now, Katsuragi Ace sits in third,
and is Mr. C.B. still trailing behind?!

Staying held back in the rear,
the pack approaches the fourth corner—
and Mr. C.B. digs in hard!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And look at Mr. C.B.! Rising fast
from the outside, closing in with tremendous speed!

Charging fiercely from the outside!
Closing the gap, catching up to mid-pack, but—
Not to be outdone, the Umamusume holding back behind surged forward to close the gap. She accelerated further, but the front-runner remained fast—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah!
...Taaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Mr. C.B.—
Is she in trouble?! Is Mr. C.B. in trouble?!
(Murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, Katsuragi Ace takes the lead!
Katsuragi Ace is completely out in front!
—Katsuragi Ace finishes first!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haah...!
Aaah... I couldn't catch up.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...I won.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I won, I won! I really won!!
HELL YEAAAAAHHHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha...!
Argh, damn it...!

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text:
W-What...!?
No way! C.B. got 4th place!?

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Why, C.B....?
You're supposed to be strong...

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Did her late-race burst lack sharpness?
No, but it certainly didn't look that way to me.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
The overall pace was too slow.
It favored the front runners, so...
Chasers really are just high-risk.

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"True, with skills like C.B.'s,
running as a Front Runner would probably boost her win rate quite a bit..."

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Front-running makes it easier to control the whole pace,
and if you strike when the moment's right, winning is totally doable!"

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"From here on out, it's the Senior class, huh...
...Maybe I should try writing a letter to C.B."

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
They might not end up reading it, but hey,
it might prevent something like what happened today.
—And after overhearing that conversation...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hey, were the folks in the stands saying something about a letter for me?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I overheard you guys.
Did something happen?
Should I say something or not... That said, what was being discussed felt more like a debate than mere criticism.
Relaying what I heard as honestly as possible—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh, my fans sure are incredible!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Trainers have been telling me the exact same thing
since way back when.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Chasing is too inconsistent, it's better to set your own pace,
and with your natural running style, racing up front
suits you better"... or so they say!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure it's the truth.
Haven't you ever thought so, too?

"Indeed, from a trainer's general perspective,
it is a fact that the Chaser style lacks consistency."
There are days when she loses out of nowhere, just like today. Even so—
choice_data_list: Because running freely suits you best.
Running freely suits you best, after all.

text_block_list.text:
"Being free."
As far as she is concerned, there is no doubt
that this is the running style that suits her best.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Really?
You're surprisingly unwavering, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, if you think so too, then fine by me!
We'll just keep on being ourselves."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I feel a bit bad for them, but...
that place belongs to us, after all.

"...And with that, Mr. C.B.
casually wandered off."
choice_data_list: Mr. C.B., where are you going?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a walk! Surely nobody will
get mad at me for dropping out now.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "The weather is so nice, it'd be a waste to just stay at the academy!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I want to see the ocean.
...Maybe I'll go take a look.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'll go check it out.
I'll be back before training starts, though!

And so... Mr. C.B.'s Fan Appreciation Festival
came to a close.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
“—Oh, right.
Come with me, Trainer.”

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Let's see...
Want to check out the food stalls?
And so—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Smells so good~!
Yakisoba, fried rice, and hamburg steak!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Or maybe grilled carrots—
Alright, rock-paper-scissors it is, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The loser buys treats, deal?
Here I go~

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Rock, paper, scissors... shoot!
Ahaha! Thanks for the treat!

In any case, and so...
Mr. C.B.'s Fan Appreciation Day
came to a close.
